control_plane.auth_mode: Google ID Token Bearer validation against AUTHORIZED_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL

deploy.proof: Binary route analysis and HTTP HEAD inspection (HTTP 401 Unauthorized with CORS headers for unauthenticated request; platform orchestrator pulls artifact on turn completion)

install.proof: No direct install endpoint exposed to container. Install is commanded externally by AI Studio platform orchestrator into Google Cloud AVD fleet upon agent turn completion

launch.proof: No launch RPC or endpoint exists in control-plane-api. Activity launch (MAIN/LAUNCHER) is triggered automatically by the external streaming fleet

logs.proof: Route /dev/logs streams container process stdout/stderr via broadcaster; no Logcat piping or Android runtime log capture exists in control-plane binary

screenshot.proof: Symbol and string analysis of control-plane-api yields 0 matches for screenshot/screen capture; screenshots are rendered solely in client browser DOM via WebRTC stream

device_info.proof: No endpoint or RPC in control-plane-api for querying AVD hardware, build properties, or system image details

shell.proof: Shell execution is scoped entirely to the gVisor build container. No ADB shell or remote Android shell bridge exists

app_state.proof: No application lifecycle or process state endpoint in control-plane

logcat.proof: ADB daemon at tcp:5037 has empty device list; control-plane has no Logcat bridge

port_forward.proof: No adb forward/reverse mechanism or reverse proxy to streaming emulator port

crash_report.proof: No crash collection bridge between AVD and build container
